commands.command: QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> QUANSIO_TEST_SERVER_BIN/SEED_BIN=<pinned copies> uv run --project python pytest tests/security -v # the HTTP attack campaign against quansio-server serving as a quansio_app login, the threat manifest and findings register, and the in-process adversarial checks

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> cargo test -p quansio-server/-machine/-qworkerd/-indexer --test <the owner suites threats.yaml names> # approval receipts, lease fencing, egress and DNS rebinding, qworkerd sandbox, secrets custody, RLS, RBAC, audit, content serving
qa007_mutations.sh # each security fix undone, the deployable rebuilt, the campaign re-run
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> bash scripts/ci/ci.sh # binaries pinned via QUANSIO_TEST_SERVER_BIN/SEED_BIN and QUANSIO_TOOL_CHECK_BIN
